summary: Visual audit of Pulse Pro and GymAxis theme correctness across dark and light modes. Tested theme toggle, Settings dialog, KPI Performance Dashboard, and PPM Dashboard. All tested pages render correctly with proper theme variables.
critical_code_review_comments: GymAxis Dashboard (DashboardPage.js) uses theme variables correctly: style={{ background: 'var(--theme-bg)' }}, style={{ color: 'var(--theme-text)' }}
Pulse Pro Dashboard (LiteDashboardPage.js) uses theme variables correctly: style={{ background: 'var(--theme-bg)' }}, style={{ color: 'var(--theme-text)' }}
Settings Dialog in both portals now uses theme variables: style={{ background: 'var(--theme-surface)', color: 'var(--theme-text)', borderColor: 'var(--theme-border)' }}
KPI Performance Dashboard (KPIPerformanceDashboard.js) has rating-based left border + glow implemented correctly in KPICard component
PPM Dashboard (PPMSubTab.js) has colour-coded schedule cards: RED for overdue, AMBER for due-soon, EMERALD for completed
